headline: Consolidating global leadership in optoelectronic semiconductors! Everlight breaks ground on new Thailand plant to build a key hub of the global supply chain
summary: Everlight Electronics has broken ground on a new plant in Thailand, intended as a key hub of its global supply chain. The facility targets AI server and automotive markets.
why: Everlight is a Taiwan-based maker of optoelectronic semiconductors such as LEDs and sensors, which feed consumer, automotive and data-center electronics.
